data.goal: Take the interaction partners of TP53 in the Human Protein Atlas. How many are there? Give the distribution of their main subcellular location as a bar chart and the fraction whose main location includes the nucleus. Which of the partners have a validated prognostic association (favourable or unfavourable) in any TCGA cancer cohort? Provide the table.

limitations: 9 of the 123 partners have no main subcellular location annotation in the Human Protein Atlas and are excluded from the nuclear-fraction calculation.
The prognostic table includes both TCGA discovery and independent validation cohorts; a gene may appear in both for the same cancer type.
The 'validated' status reflects the Human Protein Atlas curation pipeline (discovery in one TCGA cohort confirmed in an independent validation cohort); it does not imply clinical validation.
